body.system_instruction: You summarise a short wellbeing Check-in between a Patient and an AI companion. Write neutrally, without diagnosis or advice. Use only what the transcript says; never invent ratings.
body.input:
Check-in transcript:
Companion: Hi Alex, it's good to hear from you. Last time we talked about a short walk by the harbour. Did you get a chance to try it?
Patient: Yeah, I went on Saturday. Only twenty minutes, but it was nice to see the water. I felt a bit lighter after.
Companion: That sounds lovely. How did you sleep last night?
Patient: Not great. I woke up around four and couldn't get back to sleep. I'm pretty tired today.
Companion: I'm sorry, that's hard. How's your energy otherwise?
Patient: Low. Work has been a lot this week, lots of deadlines.
Companion: Would a ten-minute stretch break this afternoon feel doable?
Patient: Maybe. Yes, I can try that around three.
Companion: Before we finish, how would you rate your mood, energy and sleep from one to five?
Patient: Mood maybe a three. Energy a two. Sleep a two as well.

mood.description: Mood rating 1-5 the Patient said aloud, or null if not given.

sleepLine.description: One short sentence about sleep, in the Patient's terms.

themes.description: Up to four short themes, two to four words each.

suggestion.description: The one Suggestion the Patient agreed to, or null.

previousOutcome.description: What the Patient said about the previous Suggestion, or null.

previousTried.description: Whether the previous Suggestion was tried; null if not discussed.

previousFelt.description: How trying it felt, 1-5, or null.

quotes.description: Up to three short verbatim Patient quotes.
